linear_commits.subject: feat: add nine-key Pinyin input with syllable selection
linear_commits.message:
feat: add nine-key Pinyin input with syllable selection

Provide a complete nine-key input path using the existing luna_pinyin dictionary.
Keep syllable locks, undo, raw-code edits and literal digits on the Rime dispatcher,
and ship the matching layouts, spelling panel and revision-bound actions.

Preserve batched Hanzi candidates and map displayed caret positions to native input.
Handle standard UTF-8 through the JNI bridge so supplementary characters and offsets
remain consistent. Keep symbol category input in Chinese mode and literal pages explicit.

Include focused native, controller, protocol and theme regressions. Keep prediction,
privacy policy, candidate pinning and fork release configuration outside this feature.

Related: #1464, #1299, #459

linear_commits.subject: fix: synchronize candidate text with TextView layout
linear_commits.message:
fix: synchronize candidate text with TextView layout

Keep framework text and layout synchronized before custom candidate drawing.
Preserve sizing and scaling while handling constructor-time setText safely, so
accessibility node creation cannot leave visible candidates with an empty layout.

This dependency is also submitted separately in #2187.

linear_commits.subject: fix: create deferred input views after theme initialization
linear_commits.message:
fix: create deferred input views after theme initialization

Remember input view requests that arrive before the theme scope is available and
create the missing tree once initialization finishes. Restore pending input state
using the current editor without forcing the input method window to reopen.

This dependency is also submitted separately in #2188.
